citation: Kerelsky et al., "Maximized electron interactions at the magic angle in twisted bilayer graphene", Nature 572, 95 (2019); arXiv:1812.08776v2 ("Magic Angle Spectroscopy")
license: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license; facts and numbers only
topic: Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy maps the local density of states (LDOS) over one moiré cell of twisted bilayer graphene at 1.10°, at several gate dopings.

facts.text: The samples carry a small uniaxial heterostrain (0.1-0.7 % across samples).
LDOS maps at all energies between the two van Hove peaks break three-fold (C3) rotational symmetry to some extent.
At each doping (about -1.2 × 10^12, 0 and +1.2 × 10^12 cm^-2) the strongest C3 breaking appears in the map taken at the Fermi level, so the most anisotropic energy moves with the gate.
When the Fermi level sits on the conduction van Hove peak, where a 7.5 meV correlation gap opens, the maps around the gap break C3 more strongly than the same peak does at neutrality.
The samples are not uniform over tens of moiré cells, so Fourier analysis of translational order was not possible.

ask: Which explanation of the C3 symmetry breaking is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: Electronic nematicity driven by the states at the Fermi level: strain only selects a direction, while the size of the C3 breaking follows the Fermi level and grows in the correlated state.
hypotheses.locator: Fig. 5 discussion: Fermi-surface driven breaking of C3, possible nematic order
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: Heterostrain alone: a fixed lattice distortion breaks C3 by the same amount at every energy and doping.
hypotheses.locator: Fig. 5 discussion: some breaking expected from strain, but maximum at the Fermi level
hypotheses.reason: 应变是固定的晶格畸变，不会让最强破缺随费米能移动。

hypotheses.text: An asymmetric STM tip: the anisotropy is an imaging artefact that does not depend on the electronic states.
hypotheses.reason: 针尖假象与能量、掺杂无关，解释不了破缺集中在费米能并在关联态增强。

hypotheses.text: A charge density wave that breaks translational symmetry has been established in these maps, and it causes the C3 breaking.
hypotheses.locator: Fig. 5 discussion: translational symmetry breaking remains an open question
hypotheses.reason: 原文明确说平移对称破缺仍未确定，因样品不均匀无法做傅里叶分析。

scale.definition: 莫尔晶胞（1.10° 时约 13 nm）
